references.title: DWDS: anders
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; its word-formation panel gives only the Grundform ander

references.title: en.wiktionary: anders
references.supports: The German entry has no etymology and no analysis

notes.rationale: Kann es anders sein? Neither DWDS's Wortzerlegung nor en.wiktionary splits it, so it is a bottom word (the user, 2026-10-27, #1241), though DWDS's word-formation panel names the Grundform ander. Indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root anders alone.
